from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
def atom(el):
 a=Chem.Atom(el); i=rw.AddAtom(a); return i
# ids
# build aromatic phenyl ring helper

def phenyl(ipso_attach=None):
 ids=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
 for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(ids[i],ids[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
 for i in ids: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
 # ipso attach is ring atom0
 if ipso_attach is not None: rw.AddBond(ids[0], ipso_attach, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
 return ids
# create key atoms first
Otop=atom('O'); Ctop=atom('C'); Nu=atom('N'); Nm=atom('N'); C1=atom('C'); C2=atom('C'); C3=atom('C'); C4=atom('C'); C5=atom('C'); Nlow=atom('N'); C6=atom('C'); Nmid=atom('N'); Nbottom=atom('N'); Cbot=atom('C'); Obot=atom('O')
# top and bottom substituent carbons methyl
Me1=atom('C'); Me2=atom('C')
# right fused ring and backbone
# connect bonds
rw.AddBond(Otop,Ctop,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Ctop,Nu,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.AddBond(Nu,Nm,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Nm,C1,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.AddBond(C1,C2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(C2,C3,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.AddBond(C3,C4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(C4,C5,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.AddBond(C5,C6,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# ring edges
rw.AddBond(C2,Nlow,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Nlow,C5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
# C1 methyl, C6 -> Nmid; bottom series
rw.AddBond(C1,Me1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(C6,Nmid,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Nmid,Nbottom,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Nbottom,Cbot,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.AddBond(Cbot,Obot,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(Cbot,Me2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
# attach phenyl to terminal imidate carbon Ctop/Cbot
phenyl(Ctop); phenyl(Cbot)
# pyridine aromatic: n plus 5 c
pyr=[atom('N')]+[atom('C') for _ in range(5)]
for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(pyr[i],pyr[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
for i in pyr: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
# metal and carbonyl
W=atom('W'); Cco=atom('C'); Oco=atom('O')
rw.AddBond(Cco,Oco,Chem.BondType.TRIPLE)
# dative links donor -> W
for d in [Otop, Nm, Nlow, Nmid, Obot, pyr[0], Cco]:
 rw.AddBond(d,W,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=rw.GetMol()
try:
 Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
 print('sanitized',m.GetNumAtoms())
except Exception as e:
 print('sanitize error',e)
 raise
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=10; p.maxIterations=1000; p.useRandomCoords=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 p.useRandomCoords=False
 res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
 print('embed2',res)
if res>=0:
 conf=m.GetConformer()
 import numpy as np
 wc=np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(W))
 print('W',W,wc)
 for d in [Otop,Nm,Nlow,Nmid,Obot,pyr[0],Cco]:
  print(d,m.GetAtomWithIdx(d).GetSymbol(),np.linalg.norm(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(d))-wc),np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(d)))
 AllChem.MolToMolFile(m,'embed.mol')
 # write XYZ
 with open('pre.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(str(m.GetNumAtoms())+'\npre\n')
  for a in m.GetAtoms():
   x,y,z=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {x:.6f} {y:.6f} {z:.6f}\n')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
def atom(el): return rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
def phenyl(att):
 ids=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
 for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(ids[i],ids[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
 for i in ids: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
 rw.AddBond(ids[0],att,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
Otop=atom('O'); Ctop=atom('C'); Nu=atom('N'); Nm=atom('N'); C1=atom('C'); C2=atom('C'); C3=atom('C'); C4=atom('C'); C5=atom('C'); Nlow=atom('N'); C6=atom('C'); C7=atom('C'); Nmid=atom('N'); Nbottom=atom('N'); Cbot=atom('C'); Obot=atom('O'); Me1=atom('C'); Me2=atom('C')
for a,b,t in [(Otop,Ctop,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(Ctop,Nu,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(Nu,Nm,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(Nm,C1,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(C1,C2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C2,C3,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(C3,C4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C4,C5,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(C5,C6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C6,C7,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(C2,Nlow,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(Nlow,C5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C1,Me1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C7,Nmid,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(Nmid,Nbottom,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(Nbottom,Cbot,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(Cbot,Obot,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(C7,Me2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]: rw.AddBond(a,b,t)
phenyl(Ctop); phenyl(Cbot)
pyr=[atom('N')]+[atom('C') for _ in range(5)]
for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(pyr[i],pyr[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
for i in pyr: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
W=atom('W'); Cco=atom('C'); Oco=atom('O')
rw.GetAtomWithIdx(Cco).SetFormalCharge(-1); rw.GetAtomWithIdx(Oco).SetFormalCharge(1)
rw.AddBond(Cco,Oco,Chem.BondType.TRIPLE)
for d in [Otop,Nm,Nlow,Nmid,Obot,pyr[0],Cco]: rw.AddBond(d,W,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=rw.GetMol()
print('pre',m.GetNumAtoms(),W,Cco,Oco)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=42; p.maxIterations=1000; p.useRandomCoords=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p); print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 p.useRandomCoords=False; res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p); print('embed2',res)
if res>=0:
 conf=m.GetConformer(); import numpy as np
 wc=np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(W)); print('W',wc)
 for d in [Otop,Nm,Nlow,Nmid,Obot,pyr[0],Cco]: print(d,m.GetAtomWithIdx(d).GetSymbol(),np.linalg.norm(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(d))-wc))
 with open('pre.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(str(m.GetNumAtoms())+'\npre\n')
  for a in m.GetAtoms():
   x,y,z=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {x:.6f} {y:.6f} {z:.6f}\n')
